name: lamini-earnings-calls
what_it_holds: Archived (13 Jun 2024, read-only) repo with earnings-call transcripts in JSONL (examples include Bilibili/BILI, GFF, at least Q2-Q3 2020), plus the full open-source pipeline used to generate an 860,164-row question-answer dataset from those transcripts (mirrored at huggingface.co/datasets/lamini/earnings-calls-qa, cc-by-4.0). 43 stars, 3 forks, 13 commits, license not stated in-repo but the derived HF dataset is CC-BY-4.0.
why_useful: A working, reproducible transcript-to-QA generation pipeline plus committed sample transcript JSONL across a range of tickers (semiconductor/tech-heavy in the QA set) — directly reusable code for turning any newly-sourced ABNB/peer transcripts into a structured QA/tone dataset.
geography: mixed (examples include non-US e.g. Bilibili; QA dataset skews semiconductor/tech: TSMC, Qualcomm, Marvell, Coherent)
size_hint: derived QA set: 860,164 rows; raw JSONL transcript sample size not stated
license: not stated in repo; derived HF dataset CC-BY-4.0
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora
why_all: A working, reproducible transcript-to-QA generation pipeline plus committed sample transcript JSONL across a range of tickers (semiconductor/tech-heavy in the QA set) — directly reusable code for turning any newly-sourced ABNB/peer transcripts into a structured QA/tone dataset.

name: edgar-crawler
what_it_holds: Open-source toolkit (545 stars, GPL-3.0, WWW 2025 paper) that downloads SEC EDGAR 10-K/10-Q/8-K filings and extracts specific Item sections (e.g. Item 7 MD&A, Item 1A Risk Factors) into structured JSON. No data committed by default but ships extraction/segmentation code end-to-end.
why_useful: Directly matches the WP hint 'edgar-crawler'; would let the team build a repeatable MD&A/risk-factor text corpus for ABNB and peers (BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT) across quarters — useful for management-tone or text-based nowcast work already explored (context notes management tone tested and failed on current construction; a cleaner extracted corpus could be worth retrying with a different construction).
size_hint: library/toolkit; output size depends on run
themes: SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)
why_all: Directly matches the WP hint 'edgar-crawler'; would let the team build a repeatable MD&A/risk-factor text corpus for ABNB and peers (BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT) across quarters — useful for management-tone or text-based nowcast work already explored (context notes management tone tested and failed on current construction; a cleaner extracted corpus could be worth retrying with a different construction).

name: sec-edgar
what_it_holds: Python package (module name `secedgar`) for downloading corporate filings from EDGAR by ticker(s), including daily filings by date range and 10-Q batch pulls; Apache-2.0, 1.4k stars, 332 forks, 766 commits, active CI.
why_useful: Simple, well-maintained bulk-download alternative to edgartools for pulling every ABNB/BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT 8-K/10-Q filing text for a point-in-time archive (guide-date PDFs/txt), which the team needs for the pre-registration/point-in-time rule.
duplicate_of_holding: overlaps existing 'all letters/transcripts/XBRL since IPO' holding as an alternate acquisition method, not new data
themes: SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)
why_all: Simple, well-maintained bulk-download alternative to edgartools for pulling every ABNB/BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT 8-K/10-Q filing text for a point-in-time archive (guide-date PDFs/txt), which the team needs for the pre-registration/point-in-time rule.
Well-adopted alternative EDGAR bulk-download client (higher star count than most alternatives here) for the peer-print pipeline; good fallback if edgartools/datamule hit issues.

name: sec-data
what_it_holds: New (updated 12 Sep 2026) open-source Python engine turning SEC filings into modelling-ready CSV/Excel financials: quarterly statements, segment reporting, filing-aware XBRL mapping, accounting-standard repairs, Q4-derivation (Q4 = FY − 9mo), caching. Low star count (2) so unproven/unreviewed.
why_useful: The 'Q4 derivation' and 'segment reporting' features are exactly the mechanics the team needs to build peer segment/quarterly financials for BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT from annual+9-month XBRL filings, but code is brand-new and unvetted.
themes: SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)

name: fundholdings
what_it_holds: Python crawler (36 stars, MIT, updated 23 Aug 2026) that pulls mutual/hedge fund holdings (13F-style) from SEC EDGAR by fund and ticker.
why_useful: Directly matches gap 15 ('13F holdings parsers, concentration history') — could be pointed at ABNB's CIK to build an institutional-ownership-concentration time series as a positioning proxy, complementing the existing options/short-interest holdings.
time_coverage: depends on filer history, quarterly 13F cadence back to filer inception
